children: Sekisui Chemical's plan to acquire a majority stake in Queensland, Australia-based homebuilder Ausbuild for 335 million Australian dollars helps advance the Japanese company's goal of expanding its residential business abroad. Unlike its domestic market, population is growing in Queensland and a chronic housing supply shortage has become a serious social issue, the company says. Sekisui Chemical offers modular construction where standardized components are manufactured at plants in advance, reducing on-site construction labor and time. The Ausbuild acquisition comes after Sekisui Chemical established a unit in Canada late last year to produce housing components for the North American market. Sekisui Chemical intends to raise its stake in Ausbuild to 90% after its 51% stake purchase closes in January 2027. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
